title: Ageable
description: Adds a timer for the entity to grow up. It can be accelerated by giving the entity the items it likes as defined by feed_items.

drop_items.description: List of items that are dropped when an entity grows up

duration.description: Length of time before an entity grows up (-1 to always stay a baby)

oneOf.description: List of items that can be fed to an entity to age them up. Can be a single item string, an array of strings, or an array of objects with item and growth properties.

grow_up.description: Event to fire when an entity grows up. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

transform_item.description: The feed item used will transform to this item upon successful interaction. Format: itemName:auxValue

interact_filters.description: List of conditions to meet so that the entity can be fed.

growth.description: How much the entity ages when fed this item.
